happening.subject: item/the-muster-roll
happening.text: The clerk comes into the chapel at dusk to make it ready for the muster.

happening.subject: item/the-muster-roll
happening.text: The clerk takes the muster roll out of the vestry chest.

objectives.hint: It is kept in the vestry chest beside the altar.
objectives.title: Take the muster roll

happening.subject: item/the-watch-lantern
happening.text: The clerk takes the watch lantern out of the barrel under the stair.

objectives.hint: The barrel at the foot of the loft stair.
objectives.title: Take the watch lantern

happening.subject: item/the-muster-roll
happening.text: The clerk lays the muster roll on the loft lectern and lets go of it.

objectives.hint: Up the stair by the west wall, at the loft rail.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The lectern is bare. The roll goes here, in your hand.
objectives.title: Lay the roll on the lectern

happening.subject: item/the-watch-lantern
happening.text: The clerk hangs the watch lantern on the chain over the lectern.

objectives.hint: The chain hanging from the loft beam, beside the lectern.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The chain ends in an empty hook. The lantern goes here, in your hand.
objectives.title: Hang the lantern on the hook

happening.subject: item/the-muster-roll
happening.text: The roll lies on the lectern under the lantern, ready for the morning.
